story: Ben uses his technology to stay in touch with his friend Leo. He checks his computer and sends a digital message to Leo about a website.
title: Ben and Technology
setting: A bright living room with a desk.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: A young boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt.

characters.name: Leo
characters.look: A young boy with curly hair and a green sweater.

sentences.en: Ben sits at his new computer.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben with short brown hair and a blue shirt sits at a desk with a computer.

sentences.en: He uses the internet to find information.
sentences.zh: 他利用互联网寻找信息。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben looks at the computer screen showing many colorful web icons.

sentences.en: He finds a very interesting website.
sentences.zh: 他发现了一个非常有趣的网站。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben points at the computer screen showing a colorful webpage.

sentences.en: Ben sends an email to Leo.
sentences.zh: 本给利奥发了一封电子邮件。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben types on a keyboard to send a digital letter.

sentences.en: He also sends a short message.
sentences.zh: 他还发送了一条简短的消息。
sentences.scene_prompt: A small chat box appears on the computer screen.

sentences.en: Leo is lucky to get it.
sentences.scene_prompt: Leo with curly hair and a green sweater smiles at his phone.

sentences.en: Leo uses his phone and a camera.
sentences.zh: 利奥使用他的手机和一台照相机。
sentences.scene_prompt: Leo holds a small smartphone and a black camera in his hands.

sentences.en: The boy uses a telephone to call Ben.
sentences.zh: 这个男孩用电话给本打电话。
sentences.scene_prompt: Leo holds a telephone to his ear and smiles.

sentences.en: The machine arrives at the hotel.
sentences.scene_prompt: A small electronic machine sits on a table inside a hotel room.
